I'll be frank since this is a review.

There are many small dogs, and the long line of luxury cars at drop-off time is a bit overwhelming, but it's a gathering of well-groomed dogs, clean and tidy, and yet there's no troublesome socializing among the owners; everyone is friendly.

If owners find a dog they get along with based on the videos and daily reports they receive, they seem to arrange for the dogs to meet on the same day via personal Instagram DMs.

The Meguro branch has seen an increase in adult dogs, so those hoping for puppy lessons might want to try out several kindergartens. The playroom is small, so there seem to be fewer active dogs or breeds that like to run around.

Also, there are discounts if you fully utilize the grooming, hotel, and kindergarten services, making it cost-effective. Many dogs use the grooming service in conjunction with the kindergarten. The hotel is unattended for 12 hours from 8 PM to 8 AM, and only cage-type rooms are available. The Tapo camera monitoring cannot be viewed from home. Dogs sensitive to the clicking sound of the camera seem to have trouble sleeping soundly. I once monitored a junior suite (a box-shaped room) with a camera, and the dog only slept for two hours. It was jumping around and barking constantly, which was worrying, but I was told it was asleep. It seems they don't do thorough nighttime monitoring. Also, the hotel's walk video showed the dog pulling on the leash and dashing for several minutes, despite extensive training sessions where we practiced walking beside the dog. There was absolutely no sign of obedience training. We haven't used the hotel since.


The kindergarten teachers, since 2025, have been hiring two new graduates per branch, and while the lead work is standardized, I feel the level of indoor training has declined. Previously, they offered activities like skateboarding, dog dancing, and mini agility with experienced teachers, but now, even when asked, they seem unwilling, and it often becomes repetitive.


Around the age of two, dogs either complete a full training cycle and graduate, or continue for boarding purposes, simply for enjoyment.


Furthermore, it's a shame that they don't offer obedience training (heel training) or clicker shaping, the building's structure prevents the doorbell from ringing in the playroom, the walking routes are limited to the nearby green spaces and monotonous, and pack walks aren't possible in the summer. (Some kindergartens change the walks to early mornings or include water play.)

On the other hand, there are three optional events a year, such as a swimming pool, Christmas party, and sports day, which are enjoyable.

Overall, it feels more like a children's kindergarten; those seeking a private-level dog school or rigorous training might be better off elsewhere.

I also spoke to former teachers, and they said the working environment is very good. The teacher retention rate is high, so there's no need to worry about that. There are no teachers with low voices or those who are overbearing.

We have been looking after him at DOG RHYTHM since May of last year.
He is shy and easily scared of people and other dogs, so I wasn't sure at first...
But now he's started playing with other dogs, and we go on walks together. I can see how he's doing from the videos and photos he sends me, so it's great to see him having fun, and I can leave him in their care with peace of mind.

He enjoyed spending time with his trainer and playing with his dog friends.
He sends me photos and videos, so I can see how he spent his day and feel at ease.

My Chihuahua has been attending our training course since he was 9 months old.
He likes people more than dogs, but it takes him a while to get used to people, but he loves the teachers.
He's always happy to come to the daycare.
He seems to really enjoy his training, with a big smile on his face. We also receive videos and photos, which gives us peace of mind.
All the staff members were very kind to my dog, so I felt at ease leaving him in their care.

The teachers are so kind, and my dog ​​even enjoys walks with friends, which he usually dislikes!
It's also very convenient that we can request shampooing and grooming on the days he's at daycare!
Since it's a familiar place, I feel completely at ease leaving him at the hotel!

I was a little anxious about getting a dog for the first time, but the staff are so kind to both dogs and people, and they've taken such good care of us.

I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​at the daycare and hotel, and my dog ​​is having a wonderful time.

We have been using Dog Rhythm's services for about a year now. Previously, we used their Setagaya branch, but we switched to the Meguro branch after moving. They are flexible and will accommodate changes to the branch if there is availability ✨ My dog ​​used to be easy to care for, but after he turned one year old, he started barking and getting into mischief more often, and I was worried that he would run away from other dogs at the dog park and not be able to play with them. So I was looking for a daycare where he could be taught obedience and play with other dogs. My dog, who used to run away from other dogs so much, now actively greets new friends and seems to be enjoying the dog-rushing he's always wanted to do. Of course, they also tailor the obedience training to my dog, such as teaching him to make eye contact and getting used to the sound of the doorbell. Thanks to them, we can now enjoy peaceful time at home and walks. The indoors are always clean, and the room temperature seems to be adjusted to suit the dogs. Also, while my dog ​​is in your care, I receive multiple photos and videos, which allows me to review the lesson content at home and see how my dog ​​is interacting with other dogs, which is very reassuring! The teachers are always kind, and my dog ​​is very happy. My dog ​​loves Dog Rhythm and waits at the entrance for hours when he knows it's a day to go! There are also events like swimming and sports days, which are a lot of fun! Animals don't lie, so I know that this is a very happy place for my dog. I look forward to continuing to use your services in the future 🐏
My dog ​​always looks forward to coming here, and the staff are all very kind, polite, and reassuring.

My dog ​​has been attending daycare for almost two years now! The teachers are always cheerful and kind, so I feel at ease leaving him there. My dog ​​seems to really enjoy daycare; he always runs there and is exhausted when we get home, sleeping soundly the whole time. They send us photos and videos of his training sessions each time, celebrate his birthday, and have events like swimming in the pool during the summer, which is fun for the owner too!

The teachers are kind, and I feel at ease leaving my child in their care.

I also appreciate the detailed communication.

My dog ​​is always well cared for here. She gets to communicate with the other dogs, and most importantly, the teachers are kind and teach her many things. She looks forward to going every week, and I feel completely at ease leaving her there.

I also enjoy receiving photos and videos of her days at daycare via LINE.

Thank you for your continued support.

All the trainers are very kind and friendly to dogs.

The videos and photos they send each time are incredibly helpful because I can see how my dog ​​is doing while I'm there.

Thank you so much for everything you always do for us ♡♡♡
My dog ​​absolutely adores Dr. Zen ♡
You also have a hotel, so I feel at ease knowing we're there in case of any problems.

We've been using DOG RHYTHM for about four years now.

My dog ​​loves it here, and we use both their daycare and pet hotel services.

The staff are always smiling and kind, so I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them.

They send us photos of my dog ​​each time we use their services, which is very reassuring because I can see how he's doing.

They also have seasonal events, which is a great way to create fun memories with my dog.

It's a warm and welcoming place, like a second home for my dog!

We have been taking care of our dog since he was a puppy. He has been able to have various experiences with many friends, and we can see sides of him that we don't see at home through the photos sent to us each time he comes to daycare. The staff are very kind and have a lot of love for dogs. We feel energized every time we visit.

My dog ​​has been attending this kindergarten for almost five years now. I visited many different dog kindergartens, but this one is the best in every respect, and I entrust them with everything, including boarding and grooming. Above all, all the staff are very kind, and I feel completely at ease leaving my dog ​​with them. They also take professional-quality photos and videos that we could never take ourselves, and we receive many wonderful pictures. I plan to continue using their services for a long time to come! My dog ​​is also very happy! I can't express my gratitude enough.

Since moving from an area with a larger space with many big dogs, I enrolled my four-year-old and five-year-old pups at this school to help them socialize with smaller breeds. The staff have been consistently polite, and their service has been excellent. They certainly have a knack for capturing adorable photos – I truly appreciate the frequent photo and video updates from their training sessions. It's great to see how comfortable and happy my furry babies are spending time here.
I was disappointed because the shuttle service was suspended, even though I wanted to use it.
